list: the official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them

trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are ticked off — there is nothing extra to do for it. Use the checklist here to see what is left, and expect A Long Road to be the last one standing, since 100% completion is the longest grind in the game.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first thing the story asks of you, so this pops within your first session. No preparation is needed; just follow the on-screen prompts through the mission to its end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies cannot be missed, so keep playing the main missions in order and this unlocks when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable and is awarded when the chapter ends — just play the story through.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep working through the main missions in order; the trophy unlocks as the chapter closes and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the others it unlocks automatically when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It unlocks the moment the last mission ends, and free roam continues afterwards, so finishing the story loses you nothing — everything left can be cleaned up after the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock automatically when the mission ends, so play through the story in order and this one comes to you.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-mission trophy, so it cannot be missed — finish the heist and it pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it unlocks on its own when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the main missions in order and this unlocks when Headliners ends — it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A main-mission trophy, awarded automatically when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy follows — no side requirements, and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% completion, tracked under Progress > Stats once the story is done. The checklist is long — story finished; 100 optional tasks; 39 Gang Operations; 22 Bank Jobs; 7 Payday Loan Jobs; 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs; 50 of 91 Stick Ups; 8 Bank Vaults; $100,000 of narcotics fenced, $100,000 of jewelry, $250,000 of Marked Bills and $200,000 of vehicles; 5 of 7 Kenton's Treasure Sets; 15 of 18 Collectible Card sets; 100 WAiNK scans; 33 Underwater Discoveries; 30 of 34 magazines, books and comics; 15 of 18 meditations; 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos; both playlists; 70 of 79 styles; 200 of 277 base-model vehicles; 50 of 66 weapons; 100 of 255 animals; 30 of 40 races won; 10 of 13 race gold medals; all 42 Shooting Range golds; all 4 video games; 5 of 7 pool opponents; mini golf 2 of 3; 90 of 100 basketball hoops; all 42 drone time trials; 300 of 397 stunts; 70 of 80 challenges; all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Work through the Stats checklist in free roam — nothing on it is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps all count. There are 397 stunts in total, and 100% completion needs 300, so keep chaining them after this pops. Stunt jumps are marked in the world; use fast cars and aircraft to reach them.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — you do not need to win or finish any of them, just sample every one. Open the activities list and tick them off one by one; the trophy pops on the ninth type.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Learn each range's layout and scoring, then replay challenges until every one shows gold — bronze and silver do not count, and all 42 golds are also needed for 100% completion.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line, cut corners where the gates allow, and retry a location until the win registers. The 42 drone time trials also feed 100% completion.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count, so work through the race list across Leonida. 100% completion wants 30 of 40 races won, so this trophy is a milestone on the way there.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spots, watch the line tension, and reel him in — if you lose, run the challenge again until you win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through — a single completion is all it takes, and all 4 video games are needed for 100% completion anyway.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia and follow the missions through to their last one; the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's missions in order until the last one ends — a questline finale, not a missable one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission chain to its end and the trophy unlocks with the finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; take every one you meet and finish each strand. PowerPyx notes it is still confirming exactly which strands count, so finish more than 8 to be safe.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's missions through to the last one; the trophy pops when the finale ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only, so play it as Jason and follow the chain to its final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — the only trophy that can be missed. Start in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the morning — follow her to the balcony at Jason's house and accept. Do it before leaving Chapter 1, or the spot may be gone for good. The last spot needs both characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. 100% completion only needs 15 of 18, but this trophy needs all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts are Jason-only: he sends you after one of 8 unique animals, so track it, take the shot and bring it back. The 8 unique animals also feed the Legendary Hunter challenge, and 15 Target Decks feed 100% completion.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the state; find cards in the world, trade duplicates, and finish any 3 sets. 100% completion needs 15 of 18, so keep collecting after this pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open WAiNK near anything notable and scan it; the counter climbs as you explore. 100% completion also wants 100 scans, so scan everything you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, spanning combat, driving, flying and more; 100% completion needs 70. Pick the groups that suit your playstyle and work through them in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the heat to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight until the wanted level clears. PowerPyx's tip: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easiest escape — police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight, and the trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays live — do not let it drop between robberies. PowerPyx's tip: the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well for this.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new base-model vehicle you spot or drive counts toward the total; there are 277 in the state, and 100% completion needs 200. Scan vehicles as you go during the story so the grind is shorter later.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. PowerPyx's tip: buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang members at their illegal operations.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off with it. Get onto the airfield, board a plane that is about to leave, and get airborne.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat — the description's hint about Rhinos is the clue. Find a Rhino at a military site, take it, and fire on enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock in Chapter 4 through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — do that first, then hit five vaults and get clear each time. 100% completion needs all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat — a quick hit-and-run that pairs well with the other robbery trophies.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every named region of the state, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. Drive, fly and sail into each area until the map is filled in; the trophy pops when the last region registers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it, and get out. Each gang's turf holds its own operations, so work across the whole map — and gang members at these operations are the right targets for Gunslinger too.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The method for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx, KeenGamer and gamemapa all list it as unknown — so do not chase rumoured steps. Wait for a confirmed method to be published before spending time on it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The method for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx, KeenGamer and gamemapa all list it as unknown. Do not follow rumoured steps; wait for a confirmed method.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: steal the three key valuables there and escape. Get in, grab all three, and leave before security locks the place down.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train Strength with both characters — gym work and melee — until each one is maxed out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Everything from crimes to encounters feeds the profile count; play normally and it climbs, and check Progress > Stats to see where you stand.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The method for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx, KeenGamer and gamemapa all list it as unknown. Do not follow rumoured steps; wait for a confirmed method to be published.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The method for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx, KeenGamer and gamemapa all list it as unknown. Treat any rumoured method as unverified until a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. It is reported as knocking over bowling pins with a melee drive-by, but KeenGamer and gamemapa say the precise method is still being confirmed — treat that as a report, not a confirmed method, and wait for confirmation before grinding it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the same $250,000 counts toward 100% completion, so this is progress twice over.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, food and gear — every shop purchase counts, so this climbs naturally as you play through the story and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; each one also gives you storage for your vehicle collection, which helps with Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register each one in the app until you reach 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
